absences: No vendor milestone dated after 2026-10-30 was found for any shipped or non-table 1-20 MWe vendor. Search indexes returned nothing newer than about 2026-10-08 for these vendors, and the primary newsrooms that could be fetched were stale or blocked.

Radiant newsroom and blog pages returned HTTP 403 to WebFetch (radiantnuclear.com/news, /blog/triso-fuel-inl, /blog/kaleidos-shipped). Radiant's DOME milestone (shipped target '2026 Q3', DOME campaign complete) could not be checked against a Radiant page. World Nuclear News dated 2026-08-18 still gives the Q3 target and says Kaleidos left El Segundo on 12 August. No completion report was found. Not written as a check because no fetched page shows a new status.
Radiant's Kaleidos criticality at DOME: no report found. Search summaries from August say the unit was still in transit to INL with fuel loading pending.
Antares Mark-0 date 2026-06-04 and Series C and Space Force items were not re-fetched. They are in news and were not rechecked.

Last Energy PWR-5 criticality: no 2026 news found. The DOE PDSA approval is dated 2026-05-28 on Last Energy's own release (fetched), which matches the news skip entry from 2026-05-29. Criticality was expected 'this summer' per a secondary report; no confirmation found.

Aalo-X: a search summary says the critical test reactor reached criticality on 4 July 2026 under a DOE execution order signed 25 June. The Business Wire release (streetinsider) returned 403, so the summary is snippet-only and no check was written.

Valar Beehive: the shipped note says Utah Trust Lands approved a lease of more than 640 acres on 17 Sept 2026. The lease approval was not confirmed by a fetched page, so the check covers only the BLM status sentence.
Oklo Aurora 2028 startup target and BWXT BANR Fort Campbell timing: no new dated source found in this pass.
Deployable Energy 2027 DOME selection: already in news skip (2026-09-30). A Deployable item after 10-30 was not found.

NANO Nuclear KRONOS MMR: latest found is the Q3 FY2026 earnings release dated 2026-08-12. The Q3 fiscal release and the Hyundai MOU (2026-10-27, in news skip) are the newest. No post-10-30 event found.
Natura Resources MSR-1: search returned 2024-era material only. No 2026 vendor milestone found.

Steady Energy: trading on First North Finland was expected from 2 October 2026 and the EIB loan is in news skip (2026-09-15). The LDR-50 is a 50 MWth heat-only design, outside the 1-20 MWe electric scope, so no Type N item was written.
Terra Innovatum: NRC readiness assessment (entrance meeting 10 Aug 2026, about six weeks) and the Waiken LOI are dated before 10-30 and are outside the window. Blue Energy: no results at all.
